subject: Animation
title: Looney Tunes on Saturday Morning
description: A fast breakdown of Looney Tunes on Saturday Morning for builders.

hook.text: Bugs Bunny and friends were made for movie theaters, but Saturday morning TV gave them a second life.

buildup.text: Warner Bros. repackaged its theatrical shorts for television in the 1960s, reaching a massive new audience.

discovery.text: Kids who never went to theaters discovered Bugs, Daffy, and Tweety through weekend morning programming.

twist.text: Networks edited out violence, so many children saw censored versions of the originals for decades.

climax.text: Saturday morning reruns turned theater-era cartoons into the most recognized animated characters alive.

punchline.text: Old movie cartoons became every kid's Saturday ritual.

quiz.question: How did Looney Tunes characters become so widely known among children?
options: Through a theme park in the 1970s
Saturday morning TV repackaged theatrical shorts, reaching a massive new audience of kids
Through a successful line of children's books
